Fleet-wide synlynk capability report aggregation (#1993) across workspaces remains blocked on #1926/#1831's shard consolidation.

capability_policy.note: task_allocation below is the current interim default, not an authoritative ranking. Any harness that clears min_sample_size with better metrics on a task_type may be promoted; this requires a reviewed PR updating this file plus docs/harness-capability-baseline.md, not a silent edit. A future suspension must update task_allocation, docs/harness-capability-baseline.md, and README.md:15 together.

merge_authority.cross_harness_review_note: Reviewer must differ from implementer in harness AND model, not just role identity. Enforced by synlynk pr check from cost_entries/job metadata (gh:#1991).

governs_authority.note: 100% GOVERNS adherence required per Nikhil's 2026-10-04 hardening — every dispatched job must link a GOVERNS goal/story. Hard-fail enforcement shipped via PR #2029 (gh:#1990, closed 2026-10-05). require_linked_goal_mode set to observe 2026-10-07 pending a 100-pass clean streak — see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-policy-enforcement-maturity-design.md.
